title: How Seagliders Fill a Critical Gap in Defense | Marine, Navy, and Coast Guard Leaders
summary: Four retired U.S. military leaders discuss how REGENT's Squire and Viceroy Seagliders could help with logistics and maritime awareness
body_markdown: At REGENT's Demo Day factory opening ceremony on Sept. 30, 2026, four retired U.S. military leaders discuss how REGENT's Squire and Viceroy Seagliders could help with logistics, maritime awareness and Coast Guard missions. Moderated by Rear Admiral Leonard C. "Butch" Dollaga, Ret., Former Chief of Legislative Affairs, U.S. Navy, the panel includes General Robert Neller, Ret., Former 37th Commandant of the Marine Corps; Admiral William Moran, Ret., Former Vice Chief of Naval Operations, U.S. Navy; and Admiral Charles Ray, Ret., Former Vice Commandant, U.S. Coast Guard. Topics include moving people and supplies across Pacific island chains, the Navy's challenges at sea, and how the Coast Guard could be both regulator and customer.
